subject: run RStan's R-hat and n_eff on R2jags (coda) fit?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: run RStan's R-hat and n_eff on R2jags (coda) fit?
parts:
I'm trying to do some evaluations vs. JAGS and would
like to take the R2jags fit object (which can be converted
to coda format) and apply RStan's R-hat and n_eff routines.

I didn't see a way to do that from the doc or vignette,
but I thought it was possible.

- Bob

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: run RStan's R-hat and n_eff on R2jags (coda) fit?
parts:
On Wednesday, May 20, 2015 at 11:03:25 AM UTC-4, Bob Carpenter wrote:
I'm trying to do some evaluations vs. JAGS and would
like to take the R2jags fit object (which can be converted
to coda format) and apply RStan's R-hat and n_eff routines.

I didn't see a way to do that from the doc or vignette,
but I thought it was possible.

With a single chain that is a mcmc object defined in the coda package,

arr <- as.matrix(mcmcobject)
dim(arr) <- c(nrow(arr), 1L, ncol(arr))
library(rstan)
monitor(arr, warmup = 0)

With a mcmc.list object (perhaps produced by as.mcmc), it is conceptually the same thing but the dimensions have to be permuted.

arr <- as.array(mcmclistobject)
arr <- aperm(arr, c(1,3,2))
monitor(arr, warmup = 0)

Ben
